title: Frequency and period
text: The angular frequency of a periodic function is $$2\pi$$ over the period: \n $$\frac{2\pi}{P}$$, where $$P$$ is the minimum period.

title: Frequency and period
text: A larger frequency corresponds to a smaller period.

title: Period and frequency of each graph
text: The period of $$\sin(Ax)$$ is $$2\pi$$. The angular frequency is $$\frac{2\pi}{2\pi}=1$$. \n The period of $$\sin(Bx)$$ is $$4$$. The angular frequency is $$\frac{2\pi}{4}=\frac{\pi}{2}$$. Note that $$1<\frac{\pi}{2}$$.
